extraction.task: Resolve the remaining Giesta2 Phase7 P7-B02 FamiLock official_option_code evidence from IG3500 printed pages g12-g13 only.
extraction.prompt: Read only printed pages g12-g13, corresponding to PDF pages 156-157, of verified LIXIL IG3500 2026-04. Extract narrow atomic Evidence Candidates only where an exact LIXIL product/order code is explicitly printed and uniquely maps to one allowed existing Phase7 Option Master option_id. Never invent or rename option_id. Candidate claim must be '<allowed option_id> official_option_code = <exact source code or exact source template>'. Prefer LIXIL product/order codes over separately printed supplier/device model numbers. Preserve any code template or variant structure exactly. If a row has no independent order code, is bundled, or cannot be uniquely mapped, return an issue. Do not evaluate g6-g11 again, do not evaluate g72-g77, and do not evaluate High-size P7-B03. No Master, Runtime, Registry, Canonical or Production writes.
